name: Nishioka Manabu
source: The protagonist. Because he hates people more than anything, he lives secluded in the mountains all year round. In fact, while he's not interested in female genitals or other sexual stuff, he is very rough while having sex and doesn't care whether the women feel pain or can't enjoy it.
